replay.count_hash_command: python3 -B -c 'import hashlib,pathlib; [print(hashlib.sha256((q:=pathlib.Path(p)).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), q.stat().st_size, p) for p in ["corpus/fixtures/pe-r55/fixture.exe","corpus/fixtures/pe-r56/fixture.exe","corpus/fixtures/pe-r57/fixture.exe","corpus/live/runs/round-55/inspection.raw.json","corpus/live/runs/round-56/inspection.raw.json","corpus/live/runs/round-57/inspection.raw.json","corpus/live/runs/round-55/receipt.json","corpus/live/runs/round-56/receipt.json","corpus/live/runs/round-57/receipt.json"]]' | tee /tmp/input-ledger.sha; wc -l < /tmp/input-ledger.sha
replay.run_from: lane root or any copied corpus root; relative paths only, so the command also works from inside a corpus directory copy with the corpus/ prefix removed
replay.identity_boundary_rule: Replay must compare each saved embedded historical path against the independently pinned historical corpus root (boundary.pinned_historical_corpus_root); it must never copy an expected path out of the field under test, and it must recompute the receipt command from the saved historical path by the recorded pattern rather than trust the command string alone.
